title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, premium licensing requirements and existing governance controls are supported by Microsoft's sources. It distinguishes the public-preview targeting experience from existing controls and reports the remaining feature-specific gaps without inventing settings or automation.

claims.claim: The documented announcement workflow has a person compose and publish the announcement.
claims.quote: In Viva Engage, start your thread from a storyline, home, or storylines feed. Confirm that the specified audience is the correct one to notify. Select Post to publish.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap record nor the supplied notice describes automated announcement sending.
claims.quote: Searched: automated sending in the supplied roadmap description and MC1183013, both read in full; they describe leaders and delegates selecting recipients when publishing, not automated sending. Support's complete announcement workflow also ends with the author's Post action.
